title: CI/CD
summary: Understand the repository validation and deployment pipeline, from checks through rollout evidence.

sections.heading: Repository checks
body: The project defines development, build, lint, type-check, formatting, and database-related scripts. GitHub Actions workflows live under .github/workflows/.
The documented baseline checks should run before a change is treated as ready for delivery.

sections.heading: Delivery pipeline
body: A delivery pipeline should separate validation, artifact creation, provider deployment, rollout verification, and runtime checks. Keeping these states separate makes failures diagnosable.
The self-hosted Kubernetes path includes application validation, image build/push, Kustomize application, rollout waits, and an undo attempt when rollout fails.

sections.heading: Deployment evidence
body: Record evidence for each stage so a successful workflow is more than a green button.

sections.heading: CI secrets
body: Credentials belong in the CI secret store or server-side environment, not in repository files or documentation examples. Review workflow permissions and provider credentials whenever deployment behavior changes.
